blocks.text: House Cleanout Services in Aurora, Ontario — Decades In, One Day Out

c: Aurora homes tend to be held, not flipped — twenty, thirty, forty years in the same house is common here. Which means when the time finally comes to empty one, it’s never a small job: every closet, every crawlspace, every corner of the basement holds its share. Our fully insured crew turns that mountain into an afternoon. One free walkthrough, one flat all-inclusive quote, and a team that sorts, carries, hauls and sweeps until the house is empty — with everything that matters set carefully aside.

blocks.text: From the Heritage Streets Near Yonge to the Estates Off Bayview — Aurora's Cleanouts Are Ours

Whether it's a character home near the old downtown, a family house in Aurora Highlands where the kids grew up and moved on, or a larger property in Aurora Estates changing hands, the pattern repeats: long tenure, deep accumulation, and a deadline attached to letting it all go. Live Junk Free has cleared hundreds of homes like these — 660+ five-star Google reviews earned by treating decades of belongings with more respect than a dumpster ever could.

items.title: The truck decides the price — not the years of accumulation

blocks.text: Cleanouts are quoted on one axis: how much volume leaves the house. Thirty years of living might fill three truckloads or one, and the flat figure reflects exactly that — never the hours worked, never the effort, and never which Aurora street the house sits on.

items.title: Long-held homes can't be quoted from a phone call

blocks.text: Nobody remembers everything a house of thirty years contains — not even the owners. So we don't ask you to. We walk the whole property together, from the attic to the garage loft, and only then commit to a number. The walkthrough is free and the figure that follows is firm.

items.title: One flat price, sealed before the first box moves

blocks.text: Crew, trucks, fuel, disposal fees, donation runs — everything inside a single approved figure. If the basement holds double what anyone guessed, that's our surprise to absorb, not yours to fund.

items.title: Sorting is the service, not an upsell

blocks.text: Decades of belongings always hide things worth keeping: deeds and documents, photo albums, jewelry, the good china, war medals in a shoebox. Our crew clears by sorting, not scooping — the significant gets set aside and handed over, the usable goes to donation, and only what's left heads to disposal.

items.title: Approve when ready — the quote doesn't push and doesn't expire

blocks.text: Many Aurora cleanouts start with a walkthrough weeks before the family is ready to proceed. That's normal here, and fine with us. The quote is free, carries no deposit and no deadline, and the crew starts only on your word.

items.title: Local and franchise-free — 30–50% below the national names

blocks.text: Franchise haulers carry royalty fees in every quote, and on a multi-load cleanout those fees stack up fast. We have none — which is why the same Aurora house consistently empties for 30–50% less with us.

Frequently Asked Questions About House Cleanouts in Aurora, ON

items.q: Q: How much does it cost to clean out a house in Aurora?
a: A: The price tracks volume and nothing else. Small loads start at $125, single spaces land mid-range, and full homes — even several truckloads deep — are quoted as one flat figure at a free walkthrough. Once approved, that number is locked regardless of what the house turns out to hold.

items.q: Q: The house has been lived in for over thirty years. Is one day realistic?
a: A: Usually, yes. Long-tenure homes are our standard Aurora job, and most clear within a single day — the crew scales and the trucks cycle until it’s done. Genuinely exceptional volumes might need a second day, and you’ll hear that honestly at the walkthrough rather than discover it midway.

items.q: Q: We're downsizing and can't take everything — but we're not sure what we're keeping yet. Can you work around that?
a: A: Completely. Many downsizing cleanouts run in two passes: we clear the obvious first, you decide on the rest, and we return for the remainder. There’s no penalty for splitting the job, and the volume pricing works the same either way.

items.q: Q: How do you make sure nothing important gets thrown away?
a: A: By sorting as we clear instead of bulk-loading. Documents, photographs, jewelry, cash and anything that looks significant goes into a set-aside collection reviewed with you before it’s decided. In houses with decades of history, we assume the important is mixed with the everyday — because it always is.

items.q: Q: Can you get the house ready for listing photos?
a: A: That’s one of our most common Aurora bookings. Full clear, every room broom-swept, and the property handed over ready for stagers and photographers — timed to your realtor’s calendar, often within days of the first call.
